content: Android/Chromium background throttling: rAF is NEVER called when page hidden (since 2011). Timers throttled: once/sec batching after hidden, budget-based throttling after ~10s (Chrome 57), heavy 'intensive' throttling to once/min after >5min hidden + silent 30s + chained timers (Chrome 88 blog). Pages playing audible audio are EXEMPT from throttling (audio = user-visible), so if Reels audio keeps playing in background the session timers keep running - session time must be gated on visibility, not just timer ticks. Android WebView backgrounding depends on host calling webView.onPause(); visibilitychange may not fire otherwise.
